independent_reference.source: (1) Hand-derivation in tools/testkit/golden/derivations/dfsph-density-evolution.md § 3: substitute the cubic-spline kernel formula at q=0 and q=0.5 to obtain rho_0 = (1 + 0.71875)/pi, and substitute the gradient formula at q=0.5 with f'(0.5)=-0.9375 to obtain drho_dt = -0.9375/pi. (2) Bender, J. & Koschier, D. (2015), 'Divergence-free smoothed particle hydrodynamics', SCA '15, 147-155, DOI 10.1145/2786784.2786796, § 3 eq. (5) for the continuity-equation form; Monaghan, J. J. (2005), 'Smoothed particle hydrodynamics', Rep. Prog. Phys. 68 (8), 1703-1759, DOI 10.1088/0034-4885/68/8/R01, § 2.2 for the SPH continuity formulation. (3) Phase 0's tools/testkit/golden/tables/cubic-spline-kernel.json independently pins W(q, h) at q in {0, 0.25, ...} including q=0 = sigma_3d (verified by Phase 0's cubic_spline.py generator).
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation cross-checked against Phase 0 cubic-spline-kernel pin, Bender-Koschier 2015 eq. (5), Monaghan 2005 § 2.2, and a Python re-derivation by tools/testkit/golden/generator/dfsph_density_evolution.py.
